facts.value: The International Office for Economics is the central contact point for all students of the department with questions related to international topics. It particularly advises students on organizing a study abroad and supervises guests from foreign partner universities during their studies in Frankfurt.

International students receive an easier introduction to Goethe University and Frankfurt through a Frankfurt buddy. Experienced students provide support for orientation on campus, in studies, and in Frankfurt, while also having the opportunity for intercultural and language exchange.
This exchange aims to facilitate the start of international students into Frankfurt (student) life and give all participants the chance to meet interesting new people from various countries.
The Equality Council of the Department of Economics offers an English course for administrative staff during the lecture period.
